Taking sole ownership of Duna Aszfalt gave László Szíjj direct control of the construction platform he had built with childhood friend Károly Varga. Its capabilities now span roads and bridges, utilities, water infrastructure, asphalt production, quarries and technical facilities. Szíjj trained in engineering at the University of Pécs and had considered independent contracting since the mid-1980s.
